classification.difficultyReason: A cube on a prism with no scaffolding. The student must add the cube's five exposed faces and subtract the covered top area. The arithmetic is small.

content.prompt:
A cube with sides of length 2 cm sits on top of a rectangular prism measuring $6\text{ cm}$ by $4\text{ cm}$ by $3\text{ cm}$.
Find the surface area of the composite solid.

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}A_{\text{prism}}&=2(6\times4+6\times3+4\times3)=108\text{ cm}^2\\A_{\text{cube}}&=6(2^2)=24\text{ cm}^2\\A_{\text{joined}}&=2^2=4\text{ cm}^2\\\mathrm{SA}&=108+24-2(4)\\\mathrm{SA}&=124\text{ cm}^2\end{align*}$$
Subtract the joined square from both solids.
